schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE `atom` (
  `atom_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `element` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`atom_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecule` (`molecule_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `bond` (
  `bond_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `bond_type` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`bond_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecule` (`molecule_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `connected` (
  `atom_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `atom_id2` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `bond_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`atom_id`,`atom_id2`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`atom_id`) REFERENCES `atom` (`atom_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`atom_id2`) REFERENCES `atom` (`atom_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`bond_id`) REFERENCES `bond` (`bond_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE `molecule` (
  `molecule_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `label` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`molecule_id`)
);
q1: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.bond_type = '=' THEN T.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.bond_id) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR008'
q2: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR008'

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 uses COUNT(CASE WHEN T.bond_type = '=' THEN T.bond_id ELSE NULL END) to count the number of bonds of type '=', while Q2 uses SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) to count the number of bonds of type ' = ' (note the extra spaces). The extra spaces in Q2's condition will cause it to count bonds where the bond_type is exactly ' = ' (with spaces), which is different from Q1's condition of bond_type = '='.
